decisions.reason: Locating the standalone USB LDO on the main board does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its normal-operation role when the power board is attached.
The standalone USB regulator location does not alter AXP2101 power management or the battery-powered normal-operation path.
The source does not change LED supply voltage, level shifting, or software-controlled LED power behavior.
The location of the standalone USB LDO does not change the charge-status LED path, connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The source concerns the standalone 3.3V USB LDO and does not change the MT3608-based switched 5V rail.
Placing the standalone USB regulator on the main board does not affect the battery connector's type, placement, orientation, contacts, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not change battery cutoff protection, thermal sensing, or other battery-safety requirements.
The physical location of the standalone USB regulator does not alter ESP32 sleep policy, clock behavior, or wake modes.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY stating that the main board provides USB programming and standalone regulation, so the regulator-location impact is already represented.
The LDO location does not change I2C pull-up placement, resistor policy, bus speed, or cable constraints.

Although the same message establishes the main-board reset connector, that fact is independent of the standalone USB regulator-location change and is already represented by the candidate's INTRODUCE Event.
The standalone LDO's main-board location does not change the interboard power connector type, pin count, or matching-pin-order rule.
